metadata.purpose: Mainline-one HiCache state profiling suite with two server scenarios and two input workloads. The manual workload is the fast iteration profile; bench remains the larger throughput input.
metadata.manual_run_note: Use --list-experiments first, then select one or more ids with --experiment or --experiments for manual profiling and archival. The suite uses continue_on_error so one failed experiment does not block later selected experiments.
metadata.shared_profiling_note: HiCache collection uses target-level atomic fact metadata. Profiling config owns fact.class/fact.role/model_input/dag_input/granularity; C++ state routing consumes only model_input=true, fact_class=invariant_state, fact_granularity=atomic events with known atomic invariant roles. Concrete cache-stage paths and source-control-flow evidence remain source_actual/timing observations with model_input=false.
metadata.model_path_note: The current model path is /models/Qwen3-32B. Update server.model_path and server.command if the container mount changes.
metadata.ld_preload_note: LD_PRELOAD is disabled for this HiCache state suite; HiCache state facts are collected by Python probe.

metadata.purpose: Mainline-one fast iteration run for S1A: page128 + reduced L1 + write-through-selective + wait_complete.
metadata.model_path_note: The current model path is /models/Qwen3-32B. Update server.model_path and server.command if the container mount changes.
metadata.ld_preload_note: LD_PRELOAD is disabled for this HiCache state suite; HiCache state facts are collected by Python probe.
metadata.hicache_ratio_note: --hicache-ratio is 2.25 (>1.0). Iteration speed comes from smaller workload scale plus a reduced --max-total-tokens; S1A keeps max-total-tokens at 4096 because the NPU kernel_ascend path rewrites the host layout to page_first_direct and requires enough host pages for the 64-layer model.
metadata.mainline_one_config_novelty: This joint HiCache config is new relative to all previously profiled HiCache state configs, including C0-C8, cleaned historical runs, temporary validation runs, and aborted draft runs; it is also distinct from the paired mainline-one scenario.
metadata.mainline_one_config_comparison: Different from C2 by capacity, prefetch policy, ratio, and timeout extra config; different from C5 by capacity, write policy, ratio, and timeout extra config; different from the earlier mainline-one S1A draft by capacity, ratio, L2 capacity, and timeout extra config; no matching joint signature was found in the current matrix or cleaned historical HiCache state validation records.

metadata.purpose: Mainline-one fast iteration run for S1B: page64 + small L1 + write-back + best_effort.
metadata.model_path_note: The current model path is /models/Qwen3-32B. Update server.model_path and server.command if the container mount changes.
metadata.ld_preload_note: LD_PRELOAD is disabled for this HiCache state suite; HiCache state facts are collected by Python probe.
metadata.hicache_ratio_note: --hicache-ratio is 2.5 (>1.0). Iteration speed comes from smaller --max-total-tokens and workload scale; capacity pressure is preserved by matching modeling.hicache capacity to the smaller L1/L2 pools.
metadata.mainline_one_config_novelty: This joint HiCache config is new relative to all previously profiled HiCache state configs, including C0-C8, cleaned historical runs, temporary validation runs, and aborted draft runs; it is also distinct from the paired mainline-one scenario.
metadata.mainline_one_config_comparison: Different from C3/I2 page64 by capacity, write policy, prefetch policy, ratio, and timeout extra config; different from C1/C8 write-back by page size, capacity, prefetch policy, ratio, and timeout extra config; different from earlier mainline-one S1B drafts by capacity, ratio, L2 capacity, and timeout extra config; no matching joint signature was found in the current matrix or cleaned historical HiCache state validation records.

metadata.mainline_one_workload_scale: L1_manual_phased uses 24 requests for fast iteration: enough to exercise seed/reuse/backup/pressure/load-back/prefetch/dirty phases without the old 83-request profile cost.
metadata.purpose: Mainline-one L1 fast manual phased workload input shared by S1A/S1B; cache write policy is filled from server metadata. Full-scale stress should be a separate archival run, not the default iteration path.
